title: wg: protocol-06 §3 MIMI URI path-segment types are only examples
description: draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §3 (L317-345): Table 1 lists Provider mimi://a.example, User /u/, Client /d/, Room /r/, MLS group /g/ only as 'Examples of different types of identifiers', inside the non-normative example flow; the normative text defines only the domain (authority host). draft-mahy-mimi-identity-05 L407-408 says the first path segment discriminates the identifier type and makes it unambiguous. Problem: without a normative rule a receiver can't tell a user URI from a client, room or provider URI, e.g. a participant-list user equal to the hub's own identity. mimid: hardening proposed in localfix mimid-1wgh.6.76. Suggested fix: move the type table into a normative section with the first-segment rule, and say a provider URI has no path. Post needs Mark's OK.
notes: 2026-10-21: verified vs 833394a; filed https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/174 framed as resolving the L1885 TODO.
